name: The Tragedy of Eiko
source:
Eiko can barely remember her name, if that even is her name. Stalked by someone, who always ends up killing her, there seems to be no escape. Her only help claims to be too busy and criticizes her for not taking medicine she doesn't have access to. Can this end well for her?

[From [url=https://leo-prikler.itch.io/the-tragedy-of-eiko]itch.io[/url]]
